oneliner.t: No Labels Party nominee (coded I; her nomination paper names the 'Arizona Independent Party'), described as a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner and small-business owner; she won the No Labels primary 981–519 (65.4%) over John Fillmore, but the party did not endorse in this race.

upbringing.t: No biography is published on her campaign site (per FOX 10), and her GoodParty profile is unclaimed. The only documented background is FOX 10's description of her as a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner and small-business owner.

career.role: Traditional Chinese medicine practitioner; small-business owner

platform.t: 'Seven pillars of renewal': cut unnecessary regulations, pro-growth taxes, tackle inflation, expand U.S. manufacturing; expand vocational and trade programs (nursing, construction) as alternatives to four-year degrees.

Shift toward preventive 'health optimization'; price transparency and more competition among providers and drug managers; calls the ACA framework unstable and wants comprehensive reform; supports adding acupuncture to Medicare coverage.
More scrutiny of health and environmental effects; mandatory closed-loop cooling, recycled water and renewable energy.
Clear rules barring members of Congress from trading stocks.

Border security and removal of dangerous criminal offenders in the country illegally; support law enforcement; expand prevention, rehabilitation and mental-health access for opioid and homelessness crises.

promises.t: Set clear rules preventing members of Congress from trading stocks.

research_notes: Thin record, stated plainly: almost nothing about her is documented beyond FOX 10's debate coverage, the primary result and an unclaimed GoodParty profile (which lists a LinkedIn page that was not opened). PARTY LABEL: her March 2026 nomination paper names the 'Arizona Independent Party'; FOX 10's general guide shows no party label for her; other sources call her the No Labels nominee; the No Labels Party of Arizona endorsed no one in CD4. Steven Sanders is a No Labels write-in, not on the printed ballot.
